messages:
violet: Quick sync: billing surfaced misattribution where Console and quotas show project=ops-infra but introspect returns project=partner-gamma. sounds like header vs token claim precedence inconsistency after the router tweak
grover: confirmed. auth-proxy still injects X-Project for legacy flows and some services prefer that header for display. we should not rely on ephemeral headers for canonical attribution
nina: proposal: make the validated token claim `project` canonical when present. fallback order: introspect.claim -> org-compat-toggle -> X-Project header -> anonymous. emit metric `project_attrib_origin` with tag origin:introspect|header|none
violet: add `project_attrib_mismatch_total` for instances where header != claim. sample traces for mismatches (limit 1/sec/org) so PMs can reach out to integrators intentionally using header overrides
grover: Console change: request-details should show "Attribution source: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution source: header (legacy)". when mismatch show a subtle info pill linking to migration docs
nina: org-compat-toggle will be available in Org Settings as "Enable legacy header attribution". default OFF for new orgs, ON for pre-existing orgs for safety. plan deprecation timeline: 90 days notice before flipping existing org defaults
violet: rollout: (1) add metrics + dashboards (2) unit/integration tests (3) behind feature flag (per-cluster) (4) canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with 48h observation windows
billing-observability: we want an alert if `project_attrib_mismatch_total` rate >5x baseline OR any single project's quota burn delta >18%/hour during canary. also create a daily top-25 mismatch report for the duration of the rollout
grover: implement change in auth-exchange to stamp X-Effective-Project earlier in the pipeline. also add a FF `attrib_pref_claims` for rapid rollback per-cluster
nina: docs: migration guide with examples for minting tokens with `project` claims, and a short note on why headers are unsafe (replay/forwarding risks). include email template for org admins if they appear in the daily mismatch list
violet: I'll own the rollout doc and post it in #release-war-room. ticketing: INF-9222 created to track work and PR links
auth-ci-bot: Created INF-9222: "Canonicalize project attribution to validated token claim; telemetry + org compatibility toggle" assigned to nina, violet
grover: BC note: some partners intentionally set header for routing. org-compat-toggle + 90-day migration should cover them. also add a hidden sampling mode so we can monitor behavior without changing runtime precedence for a subset of clusters
billing-observability: we'll monitor billing signals and be on-call 24/7 during the critical canary window. ping 24h ahead with runbook
nina: timeline estimate: auth-exchange PR + tests 1d, metrics + dashboards 0.5d, Console toggle + help text 0.75d, migration emails + runbook 0.5d. aiming for deploy next Tue if no blockers
violet: great. keep infra/PR links in INF-9222 and keep this thread for the high-level sync only
grover: PR will include unit tests asserting precedence and an integration test that simulates header vs claim mismatch across routing paths
nina: will add Datadog dashboards and sample alerts, plus a recorded demo for support teams
violet: thanks everyone — small change codewise, high impact for billing correctness. moving to INF-9222 for the follow-ups
grover: thanks!
